$comment: Read by scripts/licences.mjs (pnpm check:licences). docs/LEGAL.md §3 explains the policy. An exception covers one package (a trailing * covers its platform builds) with the exact licence string it was reviewed under; a new licence string flags it again.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-libvips-*
exceptions.reason: Prebuilt libvips binary pulled in by sharp, an optional dependency of next; unmodified and dynamically linked, replaceable by the user. The web app does not use next/image, so it is not loaded at run time. Licence text and source link are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
exceptions.reason: Browser-support data used by browserslist at build time (dependency of next). A data licence: attribution only, given in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

exceptions.name: tslib
exceptions.reason: TypeScript runtime helpers. Zero-clause BSD: no conditions at all, more permissive than MIT.

exceptions.name: language-subtag-registry
exceptions.reason: IANA language tag data (dev, via eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y). Public-domain dedication.

exceptions.name: glob
exceptions.reason: Dev tooling only (jest, eslint, rimraf chains); never shipped. Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0 is a permissive licence (notice + patent grant).

exceptions.name: isexe
exceptions.reason: Dev tooling only; never shipped. Permissive (see glob).

exceptions.name: jackspeak
exceptions.reason: Dev tooling only; never shipped. Permissive (see glob).

exceptions.name: lru-cache
exceptions.reason: Dev tooling only (this major); never shipped. Permissive (see glob).

exceptions.name: minimatch
exceptions.reason: Dev tooling only (these majors); never shipped. Permissive (see glob).

exceptions.reason: Dev tooling only; never shipped. Permissive (see glob).

exceptions.reason: Dev tooling only; never shipped. Permissive (see glob).

exceptions.name: tweetnacl
exceptions.reason: Dev only, via testcontainers > ssh2 (pnpm test:int). Public-domain dedication. Kept with Hậu's approval on 2026-10-19 (T1.8).

exceptions.name: memfs
exceptions.reason: Dev only (test tooling); never shipped. Public-domain dedication.

exceptions.name: fs-monkey
exceptions.reason: Dev only, via memfs; never shipped. Public-domain dedication.

exceptions.name: defusedxml
exceptions.reason: PSF-2.0, the family of the allowed Python-2.0. Parses untrusted invoice XML in apps/ai.

exceptions.name: typing-extensions
exceptions.reason: PSF-2.0 (see defusedxml). Runtime dependency of pydantic and fastapi.

exceptions.name: greenlet
exceptions.reason: invoice-gen group only (Playwright for Python), never in the AI image. PSF-2.0 part reviewed with defusedxml.

exceptions.name: httpx
exceptions.reason: Metadata gives only the 'BSD License' classifier; the shipped LICENSE.md is BSD-3-Clause (checked 2026-11-28).

exceptions.name: jinja2
exceptions.reason: Metadata gives only the 'BSD License' classifier; the shipped LICENSE.txt is BSD-3-Clause (checked 2026-11-28). invoice-gen group only.

exceptions.name: pypdfium2
exceptions.reason: Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause; the wheel bundles the PDFium binary and the licences of its build dependencies (listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
